hook: The counter-offer does not arrive in week one. It arrives in week ten.
body:
The counter-offer does not arrive in week one. It arrives in week ten.

A 90-day notice period is defended as a retention control.

What it actually buys is a three-month window.
A window in which your accepted offer can be reopened.

Their current employer has 90 days to fix whatever made them leave.

You have a signed acceptance and no leverage.

Shorten the process, or plan for the window you just created.
cta_text: Get our offer-to-join protection playbook for 90-day notice hires

numbers_used.source_quote: When a company extends an offer to a candidate who has a 90-day notice period, the hiring timeline extends to 3+ months from offer acceptance to the candidate's first day.
